releaseNotes: Eclipse Companion 1.1.3 introduces Solar Editorial as the new default visual theme, based on the approved bright Canva concept. It adds warm paper surfaces, confident navy typography, cobalt-blue actions and restrained solar-orange accents across shared navigation, controls, cards and forms. The Appearance page now offers Solar Editorial as a ninth complete design system while preserving the existing themes. A one-time theme migration moves users from the previous NASA Mission Control default to Solar Editorial without overriding a theme they explicitly selected. Existing eclipse planning, astronomy learning, simulator, camera guidance, viewing safety and offline features remain included.
